## Samsung Launches Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 Enhancing Performance with Galaxy AI to Create Pioneering and Intelligent Wearable Experiences

Together With the Launch of Galaxy Buds3 to Expand the Power of Galaxy Ecosystem  
Pre-Order in Hong Kong Opens on 12 July

**Hong Kong －** **July 12, 2024** **－** Samsung Electronics H.K. Company, Limited today announced the new smart wearable devices - Galaxy Watch Ultra, Watch7, Watch FE and Buds3 Series, will be available for pre-order in Hong Kong starting today (July 12). As the first Galaxy smartwatches with **Galaxy AI**[[1]](#_ftn1), the Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch 7 integrate various innovative AI features and industry-leading technologies to deliver a higher level of performance and functionality, creating more possibilities for health management and everyday wellness. Now also supports Galaxy AI, the Galaxy Buds3 Series brings incredible audio experiences to all users with the new design, intelligent sound adjustment and seamless connectivity across multiple devices.

“Samsung’s vision for mobile AI goes beyond smartphones. Through our commitment and dedication to innovation, we are delighted to expand Galaxy AI to our smart wearable devices, further enhancing consumers’ experience. The launch of Galaxy Watch 7 along with Watch Ultra will revolutionize the applications of smartwatches, providing day-to-day supports through insights for everyday wellness and helping users to achieve their training goals. Also powered by Galaxy AI, the Galaxy Buds3 Series bring significant upgrades in audio performance and communication experience. We hope every consumer can enjoy the convenience and innovation brought by mobile AI.” said Ms. Yiyin Zhao, Managing Director of Samsung Electronics H.K. Company, Limited.

![Samsung Launches Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 Enhancing Performance with Galaxy AI to Create Pioneering  and Intelligent Wearable Experiences]()

**Enhancing Performances to Achieve New Heights**

As the first Android smartwatches powered by Wear OS 5, the Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 deliver advanced performance and power efficiency, providing users with more seamless interactions and longer lasting battery life. The Galaxy Watch Ultra is the first Samsung product equipped with 3nm processor, offering smoother and more stable operations with **three times faster CPU**[[2]](#_ftn2). The second-generation **BioActive Sensor** features three times more LEDs than the previous generation, providing more accurate and comprehensive readings. In addition, Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 are the first Galaxy smartwatches to feature a **Dual-frequency GPS (L1 & L5) system**[[3]](#_ftn3), enabling more precise location tracking.

**Integrating Galaxy AI with Galaxy Ecosystem for Comprehensive User Experience**

Samsung introduces Galaxy AI to smartwatches for the first time, bringing tailored health experience through personalized settings. Galaxy AI turns data into meaningful insights, allowing users to have more comprehensive understandings of the body conditions in their daily lives.

The new **Double Pinch Gesture**[[4]](#_ftn4) allows users to easily control their Galaxy smartwatches and connected Galaxy smartphone with simple gestures - answering phone calls and taking photos are just a flick of the wrist. **Suggested replies**[[5]](#_ftn5) generates suitable responses by analyzing previous conversations through Galaxy AI, allowing users to reply to messages instantly. With Samsung Health, users can seamlessly manage their health data from multiple devices, creating a more comprehensive health experience. The all-in-one **Samsung Wallet**[[6]](#_ftn6) supports not only shopping but also day-to-day transits (Visa Tap to Ride), bringing significant convenience to users. In addition, users can remotely control the camera of their connected Galaxy smartphones via **Camera Controller**[[7]](#_ftn7), further enhancing the user experience.

![Samsung Launches Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 Enhancing Performance with Galaxy AI to Create Pioneering  and Intelligent Wearable Experiences]()

**Galaxy Watch Ultra: The Most Powerful Galaxy Watch Yet**

The Galaxy Watch Ultra is designed for sports enthusiasts seeking ultimate performance. With its extremely durable design, the Galaxy Watch Ultra assists users in achieving their next-level exercise goals. Featuring a new **cushion design** that combines fashion and functionality, it enhances protection and visual completeness. The newly added **Quick Button** allows users to instantly initiate and control workouts and map other functions to suit their needs. The activation of the **Emergency Siren**[[8]](#_ftn8) is now faster and more convenient, securing users’ safety. The new **Dynamic Lug System** enables users to easily switch the watch straps, matching their daily outfits and expressing the best versions of themselves.

With an enhanced durability that comes with the **Titanium Grade 4**[[9]](#_ftn9) frame and sapphire glass display, the Galaxy Watch Ultra is equipped with **10ATM water resistance**[[10]](#_ftn10), **IP68 rating for water and dust resistance**[[11]](#_ftn11), as well as **MIL-STD-810H military-grade certification**[[12]](#_ftn12). It operates in **extreme temperatures**[[13]](#_ftn13) ranging from -20°C to up to 55°C and at a wider range of altitudes, from 500 meters below sea level to 9,000 meters above sea level. With a peak brightness of 3,000 nits and **Night Mode**[[14]](#_ftn14), display readability is ensured under any light conditions. As the longest-lasting battery among the Galaxy smartwatches portfolio, Galaxy Watch Ultra offers up to 100 hours in **Power Saving**[[15]](#_ftn15) and 48 hours in **Exercise Power Saving**[[16]](#_ftn16).

The new **Multi-sports tile** supports tracking of multi-course workouts, from swimming to cycling to running. Designed for cycling enthusiasts, the **Functional Threshold Power (FTP)**[[17]](#_ftn17) feature allows users to calculate their personalized FTP within 4 minutes, further motivating their performances. **GPX Navigations** provides recommended routes for users to search and explore new paths. **Race**[[18]](#_ftn18) enables real-time comparison of current and past performances on the same route for running or cycling, encouraging users to maintain motivation.

![Samsung Launches Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 Enhancing Performance with Galaxy AI to Create Pioneering  and Intelligent Wearable Experiences]()

**Galaxy Watch7: Ultimate Guide for Everyday Wellness**

The Galaxy Watch7 offers comprehensive support for physical and mental well-being, helping users to better understand their body conditions with the support of Galaxy AI in order to develop a healthy lifestyle. The new advanced **AI Algorithm** also supports in-depth analysis of sleep habits with more precise **sleep pattern data**[[19]](#_ftn19). Meanwhile, the tailored **Sleep Coaching**[[20]](#_ftn20) and **Sleep Animal Symbol**[[21]](#_ftn21) assist users in establishing better sleep habit effectively.

In terms of daily health monitoring, **Heart Rate Alert**[[22]](#_ftn22) allows users to monitor the heart health. When the heart rate is abnormally high or low, users will receive real-time readings and alerts through Samsung Health. **Irregular Heart Rhythm Notification (IHRN)**[[23]](#_ftn23) detects irregular heart rhythms suggestive of atrial fibrillation (AFib), and alerts users about the potential heart issues. In addition, **Electrocardiogram (ECG)**[[24]](#_ftn24) and **Blood Pressure (BP) monitoring**[[25]](#_ftn25) allow users to gain in-depth insights into their heart health.

Galaxy Watch7 accurately tracks over 100 workouts, with which users can build personalized training routines via **Workout Routine**, tracking and achieving their training goals. To understand further their personal health conditions, users can access complete body and fitness data through **Body Composition**[[26]](#_ftn26)**.** Through **Personalized HR Zone**[[27]](#_ftn27), users can workout at optimal intensity levels based on their physical capabilities, significantly enhancing training efficiency.

Apart from daily health monitoring, the Galaxy Watch7 also offers preventive health monitoring, allowing users to obtain relevant health information for reference soonest. The De Nove FDA-authorized (U.S. Food and Drug Administration) **Sleep Apnea feature**[[28]](#_ftn28) provides a simple, proactive tool to check potential signs of sleep apnea. The **Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) Index**[[29]](#_ftn29) enables users to track metabolic health and overall biological aging process.

![Samsung Launches Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 Enhancing Performance with Galaxy AI to Create Pioneering  and Intelligent Wearable Experiences]()

**Galaxy Watch FE: Your Stylish Wellness Starter Kit**

The Galaxy Watch FE, another latest addition to the smartwatch series, brings a refreshing and stylish appearance to the iconic design of the Galaxy Watch series. It features a Sapphire Crystal Glass that is both durable and resistant to everyday wear and tear. Various new watch face designs and the **one-click band** design allow users to create a personalized smartwatch effortlessly.

With Samsung’s advanced BioActive sensor, the Galaxy Watch FE supports various health and **sleep monitoring features**[[30]](#_ftn30), enabling users to monitor their personal health and sleep conditions anytime, anywhere. Users can also comprehensively monitor their heart health through a range of **heart health monitoring features**[[31]](#_ftn31). The Galaxy Watch FE tracks over 100 different workouts, providing training data for users to monitor and manage their training progress. The system also sends encouraging messages from time to time, reminding users to maintain a positive attitude and stay motivated.

Furthermore, Galaxy Watch FE users can enjoy a seamless connection with other Galaxy devices, including use of Find My Phone feature to locate a connected smartphone, easily switch camera modes, angles or zoom using the smartwatch, and also use of Samsung Wallet for purchasing and transportation payments (Visa Tap to Ride).

![Samsung Launches Galaxy Watch Ultra and Watch7 Enhancing Performance with Galaxy AI to Create Pioneering  and Intelligent Wearable Experiences]()

**Galaxy Buds3 Series: Ultimate Personalized Intelligent Audio Experience**

With Galaxy AI being introduced to the Galaxy Buds3 Series, users can listen to real-time translation with Galaxy Buds3 Series connected to Galaxy Z Fold6 or Z Flip6 through **Interpreter**[[32]](#_ftn32), without any interruption when using camera or social media. Users can simply tap the earphones to pause or resume the translation. **Adaptive EQ** and **Adaptive ANC** adjust **sound** and **Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)** based on the wearing condition and environment by real-time analysis of both internal and external sound, and adjustment of the equalizer to achieve the optimal sound quality. Even if there is an unstable fit of the earphones, Galaxy AI can make adjustments instantly based on audio analysis to ensure unaffected sound quality. The noise cancellation also intelligently adapts to different types of external sounds, such as construction noise, sirens, or user conversations, ensuring premium sound quality anytime, anywhere.

The Galaxy Buds3 Series comes with a premium blade design, enabling a more intuitive physical experience which users can simply pinch or swipe up or down on the blade to control the device. Galaxy Buds3 Pro and Buds3 are designed to cater different needs - Galaxy Buds3 Pro comes in Canal Type design with **Blade Lights**, providing immersive sound with ultra-seek and tech-savvy appearance. Galaxy Buds3’s Open Type design is ideal for long-hour usage, as the design helps to reduce pressure on the ears. The Galaxy Buds3 Series is rated IP57 for water and dust resistance, ensuring better durability.

With the highest standard of Hi-Fi sound quality in the market, the Galaxy Buds3 Series presents significant audio enhancement to achieve studio-quality sound performance. The doubled sampling rate brings **Ultra-High Quality** Audio up to **24-bit/96kHz Hi-Fi**[[33]](#_ftn33) audio quality, presenting detailed and captivating sound effects. Galaxy Buds3 Pro comes with **enhanced** **2-way speakers** that can independently control high and low frequencies and reduce interference, as well as the **Dual Amplifiers** that can enable high-frequency output of up to 40kHz, to give a crystal-clear sound experience on the go. In addition, with **pre-trained model** and **Super-Wideband**[[34]](#_ftn34), Galaxy Buds3 Series is now able to restore the original sound in various noise environments, providing a rich and clear call quality.

As the new flagship smart earphones, Galaxy Buds3 Series offers incredible connectivity experience for users. They can seamlessly connect to the audio ecosystem with features such as automatic multi-device connection, 360 audio feature, Head Tracking Function and Auracast broadcasting. Furthermore, users can maintain their physical and mental well-being by connecting to Samsung Health’s sound therapy or mindfulness programs.

**Pre-Order Offers**

Galaxy Watch Ultra, Galaxy Watch7, Galaxy Watch FE and Galaxy Buds3 Series will be available for pre-order in Hong Kong on **July 12**, and open for sale on **July 24**. During the pre-order period, customers who pre-order at Samsung Online Shop (<https://www.samsung.com/hk_en/offer/online-shop/>), Samsung Experience Store, authorized resellers and distributors’ physical and online stores can enjoy a series of **promotional offers**[[35]](#_ftn35).

# Compare Galaxy Watch Ultra & Watch 7 Specifications & Features

![Black Galaxy Watch7 next to an orange Galaxy Watch Ultra]()

The **[Galaxy Watch Ultra](https://www.samsung.com/uk/watches/) and [Galaxy Watch7](https://www.samsung.com/uk/watches/) house new Galaxy AI insights and analysis to optimise your routine and track your health. The Energy Score feature will check your sleep, heart rate and daily activities to help you get the most out of your day.**

The **Galaxy** **Watch Ultra** can withstand 10 ATM water pressure, 55°C heat and 9,000m altitude allowing you to trek even further, especially with a battery that lasts up to 100 hours in power saving mode.

The stylish **Galaxy Watch7** stands out with its floating design and a new 3nm processor that optimises the battery life for longer lasting power and quick switching between apps.

Compare the differences between the Galaxy Watch Ultra and Galaxy Watch7 against their previous models in the table below.

**Please note:** Models may vary by country.
